The proposal includes implementing two additional 350 TPD Sponge Iron Kilns and increasing the operating days for existing kilns from 300 to 330 days, resulting in an extra 237,000 TPA of sponge iron production. The total DRI capacity will reach 297,000 TPA (100 TPD x 2 + 350 TPD x 2 kilns).
Additionally, the Induction Furnace, CCM, and Hot Charging Rolling Mill capacities for MS Ingot/Billet and/or Rolled Steel Products will expand from 30,000 TPA to around 220,800 TPA for billets or 212,000 TPA for rolled products.

On 01-09-2002 Chirimiri underground mine was further subdivided into two mines namely Bartunga Hill Mine and Anjan Hill Mine. Project Description:
The proposed project pertains to the Parpatia Bauxite Block, located in Parpatia village, Mainpat Tehsil, Surguja District, Chhattisgarh. The block covers an area of 502 hectares as per Survey of India Toposheet No. 64 N/01. 

The exploration of bauxite in the Parpatia Block was carried out by the Directorate of Geology and Mining (DGM), Chhattisgarh, during 2018–19 under the NMET Project. The study included detailed geological mapping, core drilling of 122 boreholes, and chemical analysis of 1570 core samples and 38 bedrock samples.

Out of 122 boreholes, 86 showed bauxite, with an average thickness of 3.62 m up to a depth of 15.20 m below ground level.
